description: Utility classes for managing UUIDs and persistent parameters

classes.name: utParameterList
classes.documentation: Used to store strings, doubles, booleans and integers as 'properties' of an object such as the job. Access via job.JobParameters property.

methods.name: GetDouble
methods.detail: (parameter_name: string, default_value: number, create_if_not_exist: boolean) → number
methods.documentation: Retrieve a double with the passed name. If no value exists, returns default value.

signature.label: GetDouble(parameter_name: string, default_value: number, create_if_not_exist: boolean)

parameters.label: parameter_name
parameters.documentation: parameter_name: string - the name of the parameter

parameters.label: default_value
parameters.documentation: default_value: number - value returned if parameter doesn't exist

parameters.label: create_if_not_exist
parameters.documentation: create_if_not_exist: boolean - if true, stores default value when parameter doesn't exist

classes.name: luaUUID
classes.documentation: Wraps a Windows UUID and allows it to be treated as a string. Every object in the job has a unique UUID id.

constructors.label: luaUUID()
constructors.documentation: Creates a new luaUUID with a new unique id

properties.name: IsEmpty
properties.documentation: Returns true if this is the NULL/empty id

properties.name: RawId
properties.documentation: Returns the raw UUID this object wraps

methods.name: MakeEmpty
methods.documentation: Makes this id equal to the 'empty' id

methods.name: CreateNew
methods.documentation: Make the id hold a new unique value

methods.name: AsString
methods.documentation: Return a string representation of the id

methods.name: Set
methods.documentation: Set the id using a string representation

parameters.label: text_id
parameters.documentation: text_id: string - text representation of an id

methods.name: SetId
methods.documentation: Set the id using raw UUID

parameters.label: raw_id
parameters.documentation: raw_id: UUID - raw UUID value

methods.name: IsEqual
methods.documentation: Return true if passed id is the same as this one

parameters.label: id
parameters.documentation: id: luaUUID - UUID to compare with

classes.name: UUID_List
classes.documentation: Object which holds a list of UUIDs (note: raw UUIDs, not luaUUIDs)

properties.name: Count
properties.documentation: The number of ids in the list

properties.name: IsEmpty
properties.documentation: Returns true if the id list is empty

methods.name: AddHead
methods.documentation: Add the passed id to the front of the list

signature.label: AddHead(id: UUID)
signature.documentation: Add UUID to front of list

parameters.label: id
parameters.documentation: id: UUID - UUID to add

methods.name: AddTail
methods.documentation: Add the passed id to the end of the list

signature.label: AddTail(id: UUID)
signature.documentation: Add UUID to end of list

parameters.label: id
parameters.documentation: id: UUID - UUID to add

methods.name: GetAt
methods.documentation: Returns the id at the current position

parameters.label: pos
parameters.documentation: pos: POSITION - current position in list

methods.name: GetHeadPosition
methods.documentation: Returns a POSITION variable to allow access to the head of the list

methods.name: GetNext
methods.documentation: Returns the id at the current position AND a new value for position pointing to the next item (or nil if at end)

signature.label: GetNext(pos: POSITION)
signature.documentation: Get current UUID and advance to next position

parameters.label: pos
parameters.documentation: pos: POSITION - current position in list
